hotkey.description: Global Hotkey to open the Fancy Tiles layout editor

enableSnappingModifiers.tooltip: When set, holding the key modifier while dragging activates snapping mode. Snapping mode is always activated when both the key modifier is set to (none) and activating with the secondary mouse button is disabled.

activateWithNonPrimaryButton.description: Activate snapping with secondary mouse button
activateWithNonPrimaryButton.tooltip: When enabled, holding the secondary mouse button while dragging activates snapping mode. Snapping mode is always activated when both the key modifier is set to (none) and activating with the secondary mouse button is disabled.

stickySnap.tooltip: When enabled, a single press of the activator (secondary mouse button or modifier key) latches snapping on for the rest of the drag — you do not need to keep holding it. Release the primary mouse button to commit the snap, or press Escape to cancel. When disabled, you must hold the activator throughout the drag (classic behavior).

enableMultiSnappingModifiers.description: Key modifier to enable merging additional regions
enableMultiSnappingModifiers.tooltip: When this key modifier is held down in snapping mode, all selected regions will be merged into a single region into which the window will snap

mergeAdjacentOnHover.description: Merge regions within the mouse radius
mergeAdjacentOnHover.tooltip: When enabled, all regions with a radius of the mouse cursor are merged into a single region into which the window will snap

showGuideLines.description: Show guide lines in the grid editor
showGuideLines.tooltip: When enabled, guide lines at 1/3, 1/2 and 2/3 are shown in the grid editor when splitting a region

mergingRadius.description: Radius around the mouse cursor used for merging
